description: Defines enums, constants, and a struct for the LoaderAppMetrics API related to crashpad installation status, slot selection status, and ELF library metrics, used for telemetry and diagnostics in the Cobalt project.

methods.name: GetCrashpadInstallationStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current crashpad installation status.

methods.name: SetElfLibraryStoredCompressed
methods.description: Sets whether the ELF library is stored in compressed form.

methods.name: GetElfLibraryStoredCompressed
methods.description: Checks if the ELF library is stored compressed.

methods.name: SetElfLoadDurationMicroseconds
methods.description: Records the duration in microseconds for ELF library load.

methods.name: GetElfLoadDurationMicroseconds
methods.description: Retrieves the recorded ELF load duration.

methods.name: SetElfDecompressionDurationMicroseconds
methods.description: Records the decompression duration for ELF library.

methods.name: GetElfDecompressionDurationMicroseconds
methods.description: Retrieves the decompression duration for ELF library.

methods.name: RecordUsedCpuBytesDuringElfLoad
methods.description: Records the maximum CPU bytes used during ELF load.

methods.name: GetMaxSampledUsedCpuBytesDuringElfLoad
methods.description: Gets the maximum CPU bytes used during ELF load.

methods.name: GetSlotSelectionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current slot selection status.
